activity_summary: Hobbins was in after eight days. Dust to the fetlock. Oats dearer at every bait, with no price set on them. No rain since Aylesbury. He had a packet from Henley Street, unopened. You took it into the yard to read.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a price, and took the packet.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Gave the road in his usual coin.

facets.activity: Heard the eight days and took the packet

quotes.speaker: thomas_hobbins
quotes.text: Dust to the fetlock, and the dust the same colour
